mapper.insert: insert into business_news_collect_article(crawl_task_id,article_id,operation,mysql_operation,create_time) values(#{taskId},#{articleId},#{operation},#{mysqlOperation},sysdate()) on duplicate key update operation = values(operation), mysql_operation = case when values(mysql_operation) like 'PENDING%' then values(mysql_operation) when mysql_operation is null or mysql_operation = '' or mysql_operation like 'PENDING%' then values(mysql_operation) else mysql_operation end
mapper.select: select a.id articleId,a.title,a.source_name sourceName,a.published_at publishedAt,a.crawled_at crawledAt, a.canonical_url canonicalUrl,r.operation,r.mysql_operation mysqlOperation, case when k.id is null then false else true end knowledgeStored from business_news_collect_article r join business_news_article a on a.id=r.article_id left join business_knowledge k on k.source_type='NEWS' and k.source_code=concat('NEWS-ARTICLE-', a.id) where r.crawl_task_id=#{taskId} order by r.id
select article_id from business_news_collect_article where crawl_task_id=#{taskId} order by id
select count(1) from business_news_collect_article where article_id=#{articleId}
select count(1) from business_news_collect_article where crawl_task_id=#{taskId} and article_id=#{articleId}
select count(1) from business_knowledge where source_type='NEWS' and source_code=concat('NEWS-ARTICLE-', #{articleId})
select mysql_operation from business_news_collect_article where crawl_task_id=#{taskId} and article_id=#{articleId} limit 1

select coalesce(sum(case when mysql_operation in ('MYSQL_INSERTED') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as inserted, coalesce(sum(case when mysql_operation in ('MYSQL_UPDATED') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as updated, coalesce(sum(case when mysql_operation in ('MYSQL_EXISTING') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as existing from business_news_collect_article where crawl_task_id=#{taskId}

select coalesce(sum(case when upper(ifnull(r.operation,'')) = 'INSERTED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as inserted, coalesce(sum(case when upper(ifnull(r.operation,'')) = 'UPDATED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as updated, coalesce(sum(case when upper(ifnull(r.operation,'')) like 'DUPLICATE%' and not exists ( select 1 from business_knowledge k where k.source_type = 'NEWS' and k.source_code = concat('NEWS-ARTICLE-', r.article_id) and k.status = '2' and k.current_version_id is not null ) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as duplicate, count(1) as linked from business_news_collect_article r where r.crawl_task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.delete: delete from business_news_collect_article where crawl_task_id=#{taskId} and article_id in #{id}

delete from business_news_collect_article where crawl_task_id in
#{taskId}
